qrMenu.h2: Create a QR Code Menu in Minutes — Free QR Menu Maker
qrMenu.lead: Turn any menu — PDF, spreadsheet, or handwritten list — into a scannable digital menu your customers can view instantly on their phone. No app required.
qrMenu.sublead: Whether you're searching for a way to make a QR code menu for the first time or replacing a clunky PDF-only setup, our menu builder is built for speed:
qrMenu.bullet1: Upload your existing PDF menu or add items manually with categories, photos, and pricing
qrMenu.bullet2: Instant QR code generation — one QR for your full menu, or unique QR codes for each table
qrMenu.bullet3: Mark items as veg/non-veg, mark availability, and update prices anytime — changes reflect live, no reprinting
qrMenu.bullet4: Free QR code menu generator to start; upgrade only when you need more tables or advanced features
qrMenu.bullet5: Print-ready table tent templates — download as PNG, SVG, or PDF

googleReview.bullet2: Print it on receipts, table cards, or near the exit for the highest scan rate
googleReview.bullet3: Combine with a short, memorable Google review link generator URL for social media and SMS
googleReview.bullet4: Route feedback intelligently: happy customers go straight to Google, less-than-perfect experiences go to a private feedback form first — so you catch problems before they become public reviews

faq.q1: How do I create a QR code for my restaurant menu?
faq.a1: Sign up, choose "Restaurant" or "Cafe" as your business type, upload or build your menu, and your QR code is generated automatically. You can customize the design and download it as a PNG, SVG, or print-ready PDF.
faq.q2: Is there a free QR code menu generator?
faq.a2: Yes. You can create and publish a digital QR code menu on the free plan. Paid plans add more tables, ordering features, and advanced analytics.
faq.q3: How do I make a QR code for Google reviews?
faq.a3: Paste your Google Business Profile link into the QR Code Studio and we'll generate a scannable QR code and short link that takes customers straight to your review page.
faq.q4: Can customers order food by scanning a QR code?
faq.a4: Yes. Each table can have its own QR code that opens the menu with the table pre-selected, so customers can browse and order directly from their phone. Orders appear instantly in your admin dashboard.
faq.q5: Do I need a separate app for QR code ordering?
faq.a5: No. Customers scan the QR code with their phone's camera and the menu opens directly in their browser — no app download required.
faq.q6: Can I track how many people scan my QR codes?
faq.a6: Yes. Every QR code — menu, table, review, or feedback — comes with scan analytics, including scan count, time, and device type.
faq.q7: What's the difference between a menu QR code and a table QR code?
faq.a7: A menu QR code opens your general menu. A table QR code opens the same menu but automatically tags the table number, so orders placed from that QR code are routed to the right table.
faq.q8: Can I use one QR code for both my menu and Google reviews?
faq.a8: We recommend separate QR codes for each purpose so customers land exactly where you want them — but you can place both codes side by side on the same table card.
faq.q9: How do I update my menu after the QR code is already printed?
faq.a9: Edit your menu items, prices, or availability anytime in the dashboard — the QR code itself never changes, so your printed codes stay valid even as the menu updates live.
faq.q10: Is this only for restaurants and cafes?
faq.a10: Restaurant and Cafe are our first supported business types, with more (retail, salons, and others) coming soon. You can select your business type on signup.

gdpr.title: GDPR & Data Protection Compliance
gdpr.subtitle: How QRVenues complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and UK Data Protection Act.
gdpr.commitmentDesc: QRVenues operates under strict privacy-by-design principles. We act as a Data Processor on behalf of our restaurant and cafe partners, and as a Data Controller for our registered subscribers. We never sell customer or guest personal data under any circumstances.
gdpr.right1: Right of Access: Request a full export of all personal information held about you or your venue.
gdpr.right2: Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete menu, profile, or operational records.
gdpr.right3: Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten'): Request permanent deletion of customer accounts, scan logs, and order history.
gdpr.right4: Right to Data Portability: Export your complete menu catalogue, table configurations, and QR assets in machine-readable JSON/CSV.
gdpr.dpoContactDesc: To exercise your rights or submit a Data Subject Access Request (DSAR), email privacy@qrvenues.com. All requests are acknowledged within 24 hours and fulfilled within 30 days.

security.title: Security & PCI DSS Compliance
security.subtitle: Industry-leading security infrastructure protecting your venue, orders, and guest payment data.
security.infra1Desc: All network traffic between guest mobile devices, barista terminals, and our servers is encrypted using modern TLS 1.3.
security.infra2Desc: Payment processing is handled via tokenized, PCI DSS Level 1 certified gateways (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Stripe). Card numbers never touch our servers.
security.infra3Desc: Encrypted multi-region database backups with point-in-time recovery to ensure zero order data loss.
security.infra4Desc: Granular staff permissions (Owner, Manager, Kitchen, Barista) ensuring employees only access necessary operations.
